title: Administrator
description:
Administrator - Drylining Subcontractor

We are looking for an organised and reliable Administrator to join our busy drylining subcontracting business.

The role will involve supporting the day-to-day running of the office, including general administration, raising invoices, processing timesheets, preparing paperwork, answering emails and phones, updating records, and assisting the contracts/project team.

About you
- Previous administration experience, ideally within construction or a similar environment
- Good organisational and communication skills
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Strong attention to detail and ability to work to deadlines
- Reliable, proactive and able to work independently
- Construction industry experience would be an advantage but is not essential

Location: Barnsley
Hours: 40 hours per week
Salary: 30k Per annum

If you are looking for a varied role within a friendly and fast-paced construction business, we would love to hear from you

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Working within the Reward team, the Payroll Administrator will support the delivery of the payroll for the various legal entities in Klipboard. As the payroll administrator, you will play a crucial role in managing and administering payroll and pension processes. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure accurate and timely processing of payroll, compliance with statutory regulations, and efficient administration of pension schemes. This role requires a deep understanding of UK payroll and pension regulations, strong attention to detail, and excellent organizational skills

Key Responsibilities:
- Process and coordinate monthly payroll activities, ensuring all payroll inputs are accurately captured, including new starters, leavers, contractual changes, sickness, maternity, paternity, overtime, and shift payments.
- Administer statutory payments and entitlements, including SSP, SMP, and SPP, and provide employees with guidance on eligibility and benefits.
- Conduct payroll reconciliations and validation checks to ensure payroll accuracy, completeness, and compliance with statutory requirements.
- Maintain accurate payroll, pension, benefits, and employee records across payroll and HR systems.
- Calculate and process salary increases, overtime payments, shift allowances, and other pay adjustments in accordance with company policies and contractual requirements.
- Prepare and deliver payroll-related reports, analysis, and management information to support HR, Finance, and business requirements.
- Reconcile and maintain data between payroll, HRIS, pension, and other related systems to ensure consistency and accuracy.
- Prepare and submit payroll information and statutory reports to HMRC, pension providers, and other relevant bodies in line with reporting requirements.
- Administer pension schemes and employee benefit programmes, including enrolment, contribution management, and query resolution.
- Monitor, investigate, and resolve payroll audit exceptions, discrepancies, and data anomalies in a timely manner.
- Ensure all payroll transactions are processed in compliance with payroll legislation, tax regulations, National Insurance requirements, and company policies.
- Act as a key point of contact for employees, providing clear and accurate advice on payroll, taxation, pensions, benefits, and related queries.
- Support internal and external payroll, pension, and compliance audits, ensuring accurate documentation and audit trails are maintained.
- Collaborate closely with HR, Finance, pension providers, and external stakeholders to ensure efficient payroll operations and regulatory compliance.
- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of payroll, taxation, pension, and employment legislation to ensure ongoing compliance and best practice.
- Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes, controls, reporting, and service delivery, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
- Support compliance inspections, PAYE reviews, pension audits, and other regulatory requirements as necessary.
- Undertake additional payroll, reporting, and administrative responsibilities as required in line with the scope and level of the role.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:
- Strong numeracy and high attention to detail
- Competence with and experience of payroll systems and procedures.
- A strong eye for detail with an innate desire for accuracy
- Proficient in effective collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
- Ability to take responsibility for own work.
- Ability to maintain absolute discretion and maturity in handling sensitive/confidential data.
- Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet tight deadlines.
- High standards of work and performance.
- Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite to include intermediate Excel skills (Pivot Tables,
- V-Lookups, etc.)
- Effective team player with a 'can do' attitude.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Company Info

You may also have seen from our recent posts that we are excited to begin sharing our new company name - Klipboard. Kerridge Commercial Systems (KCS) is becoming Klipboard and our new brand is designed to bring together our expertise across distribution, automotive, retail, rental, transport management, manufacturing, and field service management. We have offices based across the world and we are looking for talented individuals to join our growing teams. Due to our growth over the last few years it is an exciting time to join us as we enter our next chapter!

Equal Opportunities

As a global company, we value and respect the diversity of our workforce, aiming to empower everyone to embrace each other's differences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are integral to our company and culture. We recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce, where creativity and valuing differences enable us all to thrive and sparks innovation.

If you require any help, adjustments and/or support during the interview and offer process then please advise our TA or HR team.

Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed requirement. However, we recognise that skills and experience come in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every criterion. If you are passionate about this role and believe you have the right mindset and transferrable skills, we would love to hear from you!

To all recruitment agencies: Klipboard does not accept agency speculative resumes. At present we only accept CV's from Agencies on our PSL who have been assigned specific position/s. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site or direct to Klipboard employee as this does not constitute an introduction and Klipboard retrospectively will not be liable for any candidate ownership or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Practice Bookkeeper
description:
We are working with an established accountancy practice in Barnsley to recruit an experienced Bookkeeper. The firm provides a broad range of accountancy, taxation and business support services to owner-managed businesses and SMEs across a variety of sectors.

This is an opportunity to join a supportive practice environment, taking responsibility for bookkeeping and VAT work across a varied portfolio of clients. The position would suit someone with previous experience in an accountancy practice who enjoys working directly with clients and managing their own workload.

Key responsibilities
- Managing bookkeeping requirements for a portfolio of clients across different sectors.
- Maintaining accurate financial records, including sales and purchase ledgers.
- Preparing and submitting quarterly VAT returns.
- Completing bank reconciliations and reviewing transactions.
- Preparing accounts to trial balance stage.
- Working with cloud accounting software, including Xero and QuickBooks.
- Liaising directly with clients to resolve queries and obtain information.
- Supporting the wider accounts team with year-end preparation.
- Ensuring bookkeeping records are maintained accurately and in line with relevant deadlines.

About you
- Previous bookkeeping experience gained within an accountancy practice.
- Good working knowledge of VAT and bookkeeping procedures.
- Experience using cloud accounting packages such as Xero or QuickBooks.
- AAT qualified, studying towards AAT or qualified by experience.
- Comfortable managing multiple clients and working to deadlines.
- Good communication skills and confidence dealing directly with clients.
- A methodical approach with strong attention to detail.

Salary and benefits
- Salary: £30,000-£35,000 per annum, depending on experience (full-time equivalent).
- Hours: Full-time or part-time arrangements considered.
- Location: Barnsley.
- An established practice environment with a varied client base.
- A role offering responsibility, client contact and flexibility around working hours.

The firm is open to considering both full-time and part-time applicants, making this a suitable opportunity for an experienced practice bookkeeper seeking a long-term position with flexibility and a good variety of work.

IPS Finance has 45 years' experience in the Yorkshire accountancy recruitment market. We have built our business on long term relationships with both individuals and clients in all sectors, bringing real benefits to all concerned. Please visit our website to view the latest accountancy / finance and practice opportunities.

title: Training Coordinator
description:
About Us

Haywood & Padgett Ltd is an established food manufacturing business based in Barnsley, producing high-quality bakery products for customers across the UK.

Our people are at the heart of our business. As we continue to develop, we are looking for a Training Coordinator with food manufacturing experience to help ensure our employees have the skills, knowledge and confidence to do their jobs safely, effectively and to the required standards.

This is an exciting opportunity to take ownership of training across our site, working closely with managers and teams throughout the business to improve skills, support development and maintain high standards.

Role

Reporting to the HR Manager, you will coordinate and deliver training across our manufacturing operation, covering areas such as food safety, quality, health and safety, operational procedures and employee development.

You will spend time on the shop floor, working directly with employees and managers to identify training needs, deliver practical training and ensure employees understand and can confidently carry out their roles.

We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes a hands-on approach and can help build a consistent and effective training programme across the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Coordinate and deliver training across production, hygiene, technical, warehouse and other departments.

Identify training needs and maintain training plans, training matrices and skills records.

Deliver practical training on food safety, hygiene, metal detection, coding and labelling, sieving, quality standards and other relevant manufacturing procedures.

Assess employees' understanding and practical competence, ensuring they are confident and capable before being signed off.

Work with managers and team leaders to identify skills gaps and ensure training is completed on time.

Coordinate refresher training and maintain accurate training and competency records.

Manage the company's online training platform, including course allocation, completion monitoring and reporting.

Develop clear and engaging training materials, including presentations, visual guides, toolbox talks and practical demonstrations.

Review training requirements following changes to processes, equipment, procedures, incidents or audit findings.

Support employee development, skills progression and opportunities for internal promotion.

Help improve the company's induction, training and development processes to ensure a consistent approach across all shifts.

Ensure training records are accurate, up to date and ready for customer, certification and internal audits.

Essential Qualifications and Experience

Previous experience working in food manufacturing is essential.

Experience delivering workplace training, coaching colleagues or coordinating training within a manufacturing environment.

A good understanding of food safety, hygiene, quality standards and health and safety within food production.

The ability to explain procedures clearly and deliver practical, engaging training.

Experience maintaining training records, skills matrices or competency assessments.

Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple training requirements and deadlines.

Confident communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with employees and managers.

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and the ability to maintain accurate records.

Flexibility to work across different shifts when required to support training needs.

Desirable Qualifications

A recognised Train the Trainer qualification.

Level 3 Award in Education and Training or an equivalent training qualification.

Level 3 Food Safety in Manufacturing.

Level 3 HACCP or equivalent.

Experience using an online learning or training management system.

Experience supporting employee development or training new starters.

We are happy to consider candidates who have the right food manufacturing and practical training experience but do not hold all the qualifications listed.

The Person

Approachable, enthusiastic and passionate about helping people learn.

Confident delivering practical training in a busy manufacturing environment.

A clear communicator who can adapt their approach to different employees and learning needs.

Comfortable working closely with production teams, managers and other departments.

Proactive in identifying opportunities to improve training and employee performance.

Professional and discreet when handling confidential employee information.

Confidentiality is essential. As part of the HR function, you will have access to sensitive employee and business information.

Benefits

264 hours' annual leave per year.

Enhanced sick pay.

Private medical insurance.

Company pension scheme.

Cycle to Work scheme.

Discounted gym membership.

Company shop membership.

Free on-site parking

Benefits:

Cycle to work scheme

On-site parking

Private medical insurance

Sick pay

Store discount

Experience:

Food Manufacturing: 2 years (preferred)

Staff training: 2 years (preferred)

Work Location: In person
